calculation.expression: IF(VIX_t > median(VIX[t-252:t]) AND VIX_(t-1) > median(VIX[t-253:t-1]), -(sum_{k=0..4}(r_i,t-k - median_j(r_j,t-k))) / (sqrt(5)*std_{20}(r_i - cross_sectional_median_return))
calculation.description: During a two-session elevated-VIX state, buy assets with the most negative five-session return relative to the daily cross-sectional median, volatility normalized. Signals use only information available at the prior completed session and are evaluated at a 10-session horizon. VIX is observation-only macro data, never traded.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2020-2027, strongest in 2023-2025; negative in 2028-2030 and 2031 YTD. Interpret conservatively because the high-VIX activation state is selective and the recent regime has weakened.
